themes.name: Classic
themes.description: The familiar server web layout: slim navy header, wide library tiles, 16:9 thumbnails with captions, flat 4 px corners.
themes.author: NOCTURNE

themes.name: Daylight
themes.description: A light theme: warm paper background, white surfaces, dark ink, a deep blue accent. Text contrast is at least 4.5:1.
themes.author: NOCTURNE

themes.name: Feed
themes.description: A dark grey, compact look: no hero, a slim header, wrapping grids of rounded 16:9 thumbnails with titles underneath.
themes.author: NOCTURNE

themes.name: Glass
themes.description: A black canvas under a floating glass header pill, a full-bleed hero with the title as logo art, glass buttons and squircle cards.
themes.author: NOCTURNE

themes.name: High contrast
themes.description: Pure black, white text and a yellow accent, square corners. Text contrast is at least 11:1.
themes.author: NOCTURNE

themes.name: Marquee
themes.description: A dark, cinematic look: a full-bleed billboard under a see-through header, carousels of 16:9 thumbnails that grow on hover, a red accent.
themes.author: NOCTURNE

themes.name: Spotlight
themes.description: A full-bleed backdrop under a floating rounded header, the logo as the title, light pill buttons and accent section bars.
themes.author: NOCTURNE
